properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the three approved buildings traced from the 2020 plan set's typical tower plans and drawn to the roof heights in the approval: a 350-ft office tower on an 85-ft podium at 2nd and Harrison streets, a 200-ft hotel addition on the existing four-story building at 645 Harrison Street, and a 350-ft residential tower on an 85-ft podium at 657 Harrison Street. Rooftop screens, podium setbacks and the existing building are not drawn.
properties.note: The approved buildings as simple volumes at their roof heights, not the final designs.

controls.label: 645 Harrison: Harrison St / west lot line (lot 105)
657 Harrison: Harrison St / west lot line (lot 099)
657 Harrison: Perry St / west lot line (lot 081)

georeference.method: Six lot corners drawn on the plan (lots 105, 001, 099 and 081) matched to DataSF parcel vertices by a least-squares similarity.

properties.license: Footprints: traced from a public SF Planning document. Georeference: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.label: 400 2nd Street tower
properties.source: illustrative: the typical office floor traced from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.1384 (One Vassar), hearing Feb 20, 2020, PDF p. 159 (typical tower plans); roof height from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.1384 (One Vassar), hearing Feb 20, 2020, draft Large Project Authorization (PDF pp. 19-20, 70-71), approved as Motion 20665
properties.note: Building 1: a 27-story office building, 350 ft to the roof and 385 ft with the rooftop mechanical equipment. Typical tower floor about 14,935 sq ft (packet p. 160).

properties.label: 400 2nd Street podium
properties.use: Office, with shops and an indoor public open space

properties.note: The 85-ft podium of Building 1, set back 15 ft at the corner of 2nd and Harrison streets.

properties.label: 645 Harrison Street hotel addition
properties.source: illustrative: the typical hotel floor traced from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.1384 (One Vassar), hearing Feb 20, 2020, PDF p. 159 (typical tower plans); heights from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.1384 (One Vassar), hearing Feb 20, 2020, draft Large Project Authorization (PDF pp. 19-20, 70-71), approved as Motion 20665
properties.note: Building 2: a 15-story hotel addition on the existing four-story building at 645 Harrison Street, which the project keeps (its 55-ft roof is the addition's base); 200 ft to the roof, 215 ft with the mechanical screen. The existing building, with office, PDR and new retail space, is not drawn.
